scripts.text: He looked like he wanted to be a professional Swordman, but he was also giving his gear away to other Novices.
scripts.translation: 他看起来想成为职业剑士，但他也在把自己的装备送给其他初心者。

scripts.text: I got bored watching him do the same thing over and over and over again, but I think the Monster Research Organization would like him if I introduced him.
scripts.translation: 看着他一遍又一遍地重复同样的动作，我看腻了，但我觉得如果我把他介绍给魔物研究组织，他们应该会喜欢他的。
